profile.headline: Board Member at TurnOut
profile.summary: Coding in the Bay Area for last 10 years, mostly client-side work on web. I've also learned how to bake bread and have a 5 year old sourdough starter. My partner and I are both baking enthusiasts and dream about opening a bakery one day named after our dog: Crumb's Bakehouse

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣ Delivered user-facing features like refactored and redesigned Creation Tools, a standalone SSR app game called CHROME, screen-sharing and more.

‣ Implemented event logging software integrations to capture user data and constructed various graphs and dashboards using it

‣ Analyzed various slices of data to look at customer retention, WAU and MAU, cohort analysis and tracked growth markers between social and other marketing campaigns

‣ Co-owned project management, ideated on marketing campaigns and product features, managed our discord and social media account, and helped in customer support

positions.title: UI/UX Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣ Improved data export interfaces allowing clients to better understand where their data was going
‣ Developed a visual representation of all the data models and their corresponding properties for data export using Mermaid Diagramming tools
‣ Created a REPL-like flow, along with a searchable list of product models/properties, that let clients construct ad-hoc queries that could be executed on their exported data
‣ Took a full design system for their 2.0 brand refresh and built out their entire component library from scratch, including foundational tailwind and package changes, resulting in 33 new components each of which came with full storybook documentation.
‣ Built out 2 of the highest touch-point pages that clients would see when the brand refresh launched that demonstrated full usage of the new component library and improved overall metrics and usage comprehension for clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣ Communicated cross-functionally to create a mobile web New User flow on React, iterate on signal gathering mechanisms for personalization and a streamlined web home feed to increase activation ‣ 
‣ Launched nearly 100 experiments on targeted audiences, helping to grow millions of new user WAUs on web and mobile web platforms
‣ Developed, and advocated for, a framework that manages over 150 experiences for all users across 70 surfaces and 4 platforms

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣    Implemented a mobile web analytics tool that provides event sales details, as
      well as real time counts for tickets being sold and scanned
 ‣    Established a JavaScript testing framework with legacy Grails codebases, and
      created tests covering new features
 ‣    Integrated Facebook APIs with existing products, while managing upgrades of
      deprecated features and writing documentation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣    Drove the implementation of front-end technologies for a website and gaming
      platform visited by millions of players each month
 ‣    Improved user experiences in order to seamlessly deliver web-based games
      by consolidating page markup and refactoring styles
 ‣    Planned and developed several user-facing features such as invite friends,
      main site navigation and a responsive landing page for mobile devices

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Implemented a system for government employees to archive and organize their permanent emails.
- Designed features to enhance the user experience such as a folder system for sorting and a variable filter for searching within email.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
‣    Lead the development and design of core functionality and feature
      components of the third iteration of the Kiva online collaboration tool.
 ‣    Re-engineered front-end interfaces and implemented the
      Model-View-Controller architecture.
 ‣    Mitigated software downtime risks by identifying issues in the database and
      deploying production environment fixes.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Facilitated the requirements analysis process in an effort to reduce the cost of e-commerce transaction errors by employing service area mapping. 
- Developed a geographical information systems (GIS) algorithm to demarcate service areas, which has been successfully deployed for over 100 merchants.
- Supported the integration of the GIS system with the front-end software by documenting the application programming interface and performing testing.
